# P3-02 names golden vectors (spec docs/specs/p3-02-names.md, approved 2026-11-19),
# generated by worldgen/tests/reference/p3_names_reference.py golden, an independent
# exact-integer reference written from the spec text alone (hashing: core_reference.py).
# Do not edit by hand; never regenerate to make a C++ test pass.
#
# Format: ASCII, LF, tokens separated by one space; a name is the rest of its line.
#   tag TAG_HIST <hex>
#   stream <seed> <name> <key hex>                   stream_key(seed, name)
#   draw <key hex> <w0 hex> <a hex> <b hex> <k hex> <u hex>   draw(key, w0, a, b, k)
#   pick <u hex> <n> <index|FATAL>
#   chance <u hex> <p raw> <true|false|FATAL>
#   weighted <u hex> <w,w,...|-> <index|FATAL>            (- is the empty list)
#   roman <k> <numeral|FATAL>
#   cap <root> <Cap(root)>
#   attempt <seed> <culture> <kind> <c> <e> <t> <valid 0|1> <root> <name>  (- - when invalid:
#       an invalid attempt's root and name are unspecified, spec 4.2)
#   step <seed> <culture> <kind> <c> <e> <t> <j> <u hex> <n> <index> <symbol> <piece|->
#       every draw of the attempt (symbol form, pattern, O, N, C)
#   scenario <label> <seed> <preload count> then preload <label> <name> lines (sorted),
#   then result <label> <culture> <kind> <c> <e> <attempt|F> <name>, in naming order;
#       one registry per scenario; test cultures tiny and never are defined in the reference
#       and in worldgen/tests/history/p3_02_names_support.hpp
#   r5 (P3-02 11, generator 0.17.0): attempts and lists use god_patterns and the shipped
#       name filter of game/data/name_filters/; the elven third form is The House of {root}
#   fattempt <seed> <culture> <kind> <c> <e> <t> <valid 0|1> <filtered 0|1> <name|->
#       attempts with the filter (11.3, 11.5 NameAttempt::filtered); culture filt uses the
#       test filter (anywhere = [ba]), every shipped culture the shipped filter
#   rootword <form with _ for space> <root> <W>     root_word of 11.3
#   filter <W> <0|1>   name_filtered(shipped filter, W) on benign words (the critics' stems
#       are tested in the C++, written as concatenations, never stored here)
#   formtext <culture> <kind> <i> <ok|message>  names_form_text of 11.3 on the shipped forms
#   scenarios filtered, redraw_alone, redraw_after (11.7 item 8) use culture filt, defined in
#       the reference and in p3_02_names_support.hpp, with the test filter
#   r4sha256 <seed> <hex>  11.7 item 7: the list lines of that seed computed with the empty filter,
#       god_patterns = patterns and the r4 elven forms (the 0.16.0 list, whose sha256 line it equals)
#   fatal <culture> <kind> <seed> <c> <e> <message>
#   <seed> <culture> <kind> <entity> <attempt|F> <name>   (spec 9.3 item 10)
#       for seeds 0 and 42, one registry per seed starting empty, cultures in canonical id
#       order (c = 1..6), kinds in the order god, civilization, settlement, entities 1..50
#   sha256 <seed> <hex>  of the seed's name lines joined by LF (no trailing LF)
# Where 4.6 falls: its seed-0 elven settlement 1 tuple is the line '0 elven settlement 1 0
# Iensath' of the list (the registry then holds 250 earlier names,
# dwarven 150, elven god and civilization 100, none of them Iensath);
# its empty-registry, collision and fallback cases are scenarios empty, collide and full;
# its seed-42 vectors are scenario seed42.
